mapper.sql: select a.article_id, a.category_id, a.title, a.summary, a.cover, a.author, a.is_top, a.status, a.views, a.publish_time, a.sort, a.attachment, a.keywords, a.description, a.version, a.del_flag, a.deleted_time, a.deleted_by, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, c.category_name from cms_article a left join cms_category c on c.category_id = a.category_id
mapper.select: select count(*) from cms_article where category_id = #{categoryId} and del_flag = '0'

select a.article_id, a.category_id, a.title, a.summary, a.content, a.cover, a.author, a.is_top, a.status, a.views, a.publish_time, a.sort, a.attachment, a.keywords, a.description, a.version, a.del_flag, a.deleted_time, a.deleted_by, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, c.category_name from cms_article a left join cms_category c on c.category_id = a.category_id where a.article_id = #{articleId} and a.del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update cms_article set views = views + 1 where article_id = #{articleId}

category_id, title, summary, content, cover, author, is_top, status, views, publish_time, sort, attachment, keywords, description, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time,

mapper.update:
update cms_article
status = #{status}, publish_time = IFNULL(publish_time, sysdate()), update_time = sysdate()
where del_flag = '0' and article_id in
#{articleId}

update.foreach: update cms_article set sort = #{a.sort}, update_time = sysdate() where article_id = #{a.articleId} and del_flag = '0'

mapper.delete: delete from cms_article where del_flag = '2' and deleted_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)

delete from cms_article where del_flag = '2' and article_id in
#{articleId}
mapper.select: select sum(case when del_flag = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as articleTotal, sum(case when del_flag = '0' and create_time >= curdate() then 1 else 0 end) as articleToday, sum(case when del_flag = '0' and status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as draftCount, sum(case when del_flag = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as recycleCount from cms_article

select history_id, article_id, version, category_id, title, summary, content, cover, author, is_top, status, sort, attachment, keywords, description, publish_time, update_by, update_time from cms_article_history where article_id = #{articleId} order by version desc limit 20

select history_id, article_id, version, category_id, title, summary, content, cover, author, is_top, status, sort, attachment, keywords, description, publish_time, update_by, update_time from cms_article_history where article_id = #{articleId} and version = #{version}
mapper.insert: insert into cms_article_history (article_id, version, category_id, title, summary, content, cover, author, is_top, status, sort, attachment, keywords, description, publish_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{articleId}, #{version}, #{categoryId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{content}, #{cover}, #{author}, #{isTop}, #{status}, #{sort}, #{attachment}, #{keywords}, #{description}, #{publishTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime})
